subject: Television & Streaming
title: Italian Television: From RAI to Gomorrah
description: A quick, practical guide to Italian Television: From RAI to Gomorrah.

hook.text: Italy's RAI was Europe's first public broadcaster to air regularly.

buildup.text: Silvio Berlusconi's Mediaset empire blurred politics and media.

twist.text: My Brilliant Friend on HBO brought Elena Ferrante's novels to screen.

climax.text: Italian television's evolution from political tool to global art shows how a country's TV can transform when creators.

punchline.text: Italian TV went from Berlusconi's playground to the world's stage.

quiz.question: What made Gomorrah a turning point for Italian television internationally?
options: It was Italy's first internationally acclaimed drama series, changing perceptions of Italian TV
It was the most expensive Italian show
